prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a hit while turning left. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1422; do not mention it.)
text:
Please be advised that this office now represents our client in connection with the collision that occurred while she was making a left turn and was struck by another vehicle. Our client sustained injuries in the incident and is seeking compensation for her medical care, lost income, and related damages.

Effective immediately, all communication regarding this matter, including requests for statements, scheduling, and settlement discussions, must be directed to this office rather than to our client. Please do not contact her directly.

We request that you provide the bodily injury and property damage liability limits under the policy issued to the at-fault driver, along with a copy of the declarations page. Please also confirm whether any other policies may apply.

Finally, we ask that your company preserve all evidence relating to this loss. This includes the claim file, photographs, recorded statements, telematics or event data, repair estimates, adjuster notes, and any video footage in your possession. Failure to preserve such material may result in sanctions. We look forward to your prompt written response.
